summary: The VivoTab is a sub-series of Asus's Vivo line, featuring Microsoft Windows hybrid tablet computers. Deriving its name from the Latin word "to live," the VivoTab series serves as a primary competitor to the Microsoft Surface. The product family includes several models, such as the standard VivoTab, various RT versions, the Smart, and the Note 8. All devices in the lineup run on Windows 8 or 8.1 and include a three-year subscription to Asus WebStorage. These detachable tablets are designed for ultra-portability, boasting high-definition screens and extended battery life. Pricing varies by model, with the VivoTab RT specifically retailing at $599 for the 32 GB version and $699 for the 64 GB version.
